channel.title: crux changelog
channel.description: Release notes for crux, the behavior blame tool for git.

item.description: First public release. who: binary-search any command across a commit range, --fast search-only mode, --parallel worktree probing. Explanations: minimized causal diff, interaction-fault detection, dependency blame with upstream attribution, ranked candidates, rewrite resilience. Guarding: behavior guardians, watch mode, deterministic replay, code and environment signatures. Single 2.04 MiB binary, only dependency is git.
